verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client, and a developer tool like this could plausibly ship a terminal or SSH session feature, so the axis applies. The evidence documents SSH only as a Git transport and for listing repositories on servers, plus Background Sync for Git syncing. Nothing shows an interactive terminal session, let alone one that survives network changes or device sleep.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can keep my terminal session alive across network changes and device sleep
